# 不空羂索神變真言經

**ID:** T1092
**Volume:** T20
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Byline:** 唐 菩提流志譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 707–709
**Juans:** 30
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1092

## Contributors
- 菩提流志 (A001358)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A monumental thirty-fascicle Tang Esoteric sūtra — by far the largest Avalokiteśvara *kalpa-rāja* in the Chinese canon — devoted to **Amoghapāśa-Avalokiteśvara** (不空羂索觀世音, "the Avalokiteśvara of the Unfailing Noose"), one of the principal eight bodily forms of Avalokiteśvara in the Tang Esoteric pantheon. Translated by **Bodhiruci** ([菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97), d. 727) and presented to the Tang court between 707 and 709 (the dating is fixed by Bodhiruci's "submission memorial" and the contemporary catalogues), this is the *magnum opus* of his career and one of the longest single texts of Tang Esoteric Buddhism. The text supersedes a series of earlier shorter Amoghapāśa sūtras translated by [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta, [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng, [寶思惟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E6%80%9D%E6%83%9F) Bǎosīwéi, and [李無諂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E7%84%A1%E8%AB%82) Lǐwúchǎn (cf. [KR6j0301](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0301)–[KR6j0307](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0307) = T20N1093–T20N1099, all parallel translations or partial witnesses subsumed in Bodhiruci's full thirty-fascicle redaction).

**Abstract**

The opening fascicle, *Mǔtuóluóní zhēnyán xùpǐn dìyī* 母陀羅尼真言序品第一 — "Introductory Chapter of the Mother-Dhāraṇī-Mantra" — situates the discourse at Avalokiteśvara's *mahā-prāsāda* on Mt. Potalaka (補陀洛山觀世音菩薩摩訶薩大宮殿中), the palace built entirely of innumerable jewels, mahā-precious-objects, and miraculously interwoven jewels emitting great rays of light. The thirty fascicles unfold a comprehensive Esoteric *kalpa-rāja* on Amoghapāśa: the deity's iconography (multiple-armed, holding the *pāśa* / noose, the *triśūla*, the *cintāmaṇi*, etc.), the *mūla-mantra* and the various *vidyā*-spell families (the *mātṛ-dhāraṇī*, the *uttara-mantra*, the *sādhāraṇa-mantras*), the maṇḍala-arrangements (multiple maṇḍala-types for the various ritual operations), the consecration / *abhiṣeka* procedures, the *homa* operations, the *vyākaraṇa* and prophetic chapters, the iconometric specifications for image-construction, and the closing dedication. The work is the most comprehensive single-text reference for the Amoghapāśa cycle in the Tang canon and is a primary source for the iconography of Tang and Heian-period Amoghapāśa images.

The parallel and partial Amoghapāśa translations are: T20n1093 ([闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta, [KR6j0301](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0301)), T20n1094 ([玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng, [KR6j0302](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0302)), T20n1095 ([菩提流志](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E5%BF%97) Bodhiruci, [KR6j0303](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0303)), T20n1096 ([李無諂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E7%84%A1%E8%AB%82) Lǐwúchǎn, [KR6j0304](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0304)), T20n1097 ([寶思惟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E6%80%9D%E6%83%9F) Bǎosīwéi, [KR6j0305](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0305)), and T20n1098 ([阿謨伽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%98%BF%E8%AC%A8%E4%BC%BD) 阿目佉, [KR6j0306](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0306)), together with the [阿地瞿多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%98%BF%E5%9C%B0%E7%9E%BF%E5%A4%9A) Atikūṭa compendium ([KR6c0098](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0098) T901, fasc. 5).
